📶 Wi-Fi multiplayer

Wi-Fi multiplayer works in the Tago Tagoan Android app. Install it on each phone, connect everyone to the same Wi-Fi (or the host phone’s hotspot), then one phone hosts and the others join.

Everyone joins the same Wi-Fi or the host phone’s hotspot. One phone taps Host a game, the others tap that game below.

🎨 Art prompts

Tap the prompt text or 📋 Prompt to copy a prompt, and 📄 to copy its suggested file name, then paste into any image generator to make art for the game: icons, monsters, stages, props and UI. The style is teen horror — creepy and tense, never gory — and every prompt ends with an “Avoid” line so generators leave out blood and wounds. They all share one style so the pieces match.

🎛 Sound studio

Tap squares to build a spooky loop, then record your voice or sounds on top. Save it to a slot and pick it as the game music.

How to play

👀 You see everything through your own eyes. Your flashlight only reaches a few steps, so listen — monster footsteps and kids’ giggles come from the left or right speaker. Headphones help!

🧟 If a monster sees you, it chases you. Run, turn corners, and break its line of sight. Red eyes in the dark mean one is watching.

📢 Watch the noise meter. Running is loud, walking is quieter, standing still is silent.

🫣 Walk up to a bed, closet, drum, tomb or tree and press Hide. If a monster saw you hide, press Hold breath until it leaves.

🔎 In Hanap!, search hiding spots to find the 5 kids. Follow the giggles.

🗺 Four stages: Bahay ni Lola, Paaralan, Palengke and Sementeryo — each with a second floor. Walk up the stairs to reach Lola’s Room and the azotea, the upper classrooms, the market bodega, the choir loft and more. Monsters follow you up and down, so stairs won’t save you!

🧭 The mini-map shows the floor you’re on (1F or 2F). The ghost meter tells you when a ghost is upstairs or downstairs.

👻 Multo Hunt is a bonus first-person level in the Lumang Mansyon. The ghost meter lights up and beeps faster as you get close, and its arrow points the way. Hold Fire to wrap a ghost in the plasma beam until it’s trapped in a net, then hit Catch to lock it in the Ghost Containment Unit. Don’t overheat the gun, and don’t let them charge you — 3 slimes and you’re out.

🎛 In the Sound studio, tap a beat, record your voice on top, save it, then choose it under Game music.

📶 Wi-Fi games (Android app): hide together from the monsters, hunt the kids as a team, or play Taya — one player is the monster wearing their own face. The Taya counts to 10 first, then hunts. Taya sees 🔊 when a hider is loud and can search hiding spots. Caught hiders become ghosts 👻 and can keep watching.

Phone: drag the left side to walk, swipe the right side to look. Keyboard: WS walk, AD step sideways, ←→ or mouse to look, Q turn around, Shift run, E hide, F search, Space hold breath, P pause. In Multo Hunt: click or hold Space to fire, E to catch.
